description:
Send an email and have it delivered to any route on the UnitySVC API Gateway — a service, an alias, a broadcast group, or an enrollment — as your own identity.

The SMTP gateway accepts the message, authenticates it with your UnitySVC API key (used as the SMTP password), converts it to the payload format you chose — the faithful `email` envelope (sender, recipients, subject, both body parts, headers, attachments) or the compact `{title, body, type, format}` `apprise` envelope — and POSTs it to `${API_GATEWAY_BASE_URL}/<target>` with your own API key replayed as the bearer token. The host is fixed to the platform's API Gateway; you choose only the route, so the forwarded credential never leaves UnitySVC. Whatever the target route bills, it bills under its own listing; this ingress hop is free on the default channel and metered on the `plus` channel.

Use the free `default` channel to forward every message to one route stored as the `SMTP_TO_API_GATEWAY_TARGET` customer secret (default `notify`, which delivers to your configured notification destination) in the format stored as `SMTP_TO_API_GATEWAY_FORMAT` (default `apprise`). Use the metered `plus` channel to run many email-to-route bridges under one account: each enrollment binds its own `target` and `payload_format`, uses a unique SMTP username, and is billed at $1 per 1,000 emails. See “How to use this service” for setup and examples.
name: smtp-to-api-gateway

payout_price.description: No platform commission — forwards into the customer's own API Gateway route

summary: Email in, API Gateway route out: send a message to the SMTP gateway and it is forwarded, as a faithful email envelope or a compact notification, to any UnitySVC route you choose, as you.
